title: A fleet lane that defers on a quota wall releases its inbox claim, so the item is re-offered instead of stranded in processing
summary: From the wave-24 P0 (2026-09-28). A cycle that ends on ErrAllFamiliesExhausted skips the FAIL closeout (abnormalEpilogue returns early: a resumable pause), so its claim stays in inbox/processing/cycle-N and its worktree is preserved. The sequential loop resumes such a cycle; a fleet lane is never resumed, so with codex walled until 2026-10-14 every claude stall that defers strands an item the planner will not offer again.
acceptance: A deferred fleet lane's claim returns to pending with a note naming the deferral, and the next wave can plan it (test)
The sequential loop's resumable pause keeps its checkpoint and claim, unchanged
source: console, 2026-09-28, the wave-24 P0 and its architecture review
